description:
Advances: bw.signal.config, bw.signal.store

Deliverable:
New internal/signal package: config.go (load/parse .beadwork/signals.yml from the repo working tree, fail-closed on malformed YAML / invalid schema / duplicate type names), schema.go (type + field model: string/int/bool/enum with values, required + required_when), validate.go (full payload validation). internal/issue/signal.go: EmitSignal (per-ticket zero-padded NNNN sequence derived from a fresh ReadDir, immutable JSON snapshot with store-assigned emitted_at) + SignalsForTicket, mirroring attachment.go. New self-describing intent verb `signal <ticket> <type> <path>` + replaySignal in internal/intent/intent.go (loud-fail blob recovery via SourceHash, never re-runs hooks). `bw signal` command registered in command.go under a new "Signals" help group, with `emit` (type-existence → validate → store; NO hooks in this stage) and `types` subcommands; storage commit routed through commitWithRetry with a sequence-re-deriving apply closure. docs/design.md gains a Signals storage + intent section alongside Attachments.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: TestConfigWorkingTreeSource, TestConfigFailClosedMalformed, TestSchemaExpressiveness, TestValidateFinalPayload (internal/signal); TestSignalConcurrentEmits (internal/issue); TestReplaySignal (internal/intent); TestSignalEmitUndefinedTypeRefused, TestSignalHistoryOutlivesDefinitions, TestUsageListsSignalGroup (cmd/bw); TestSignalEmitAndReread, TestSignalAdditivityDormantRepo (test/)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: bw.signal.config.deferral_escape_hatch_closed, bw.signal.config.dormant_repo, bw.signal.config.duplicate_type_fails_closed, bw.signal.config.enum_domain_enforced, bw.signal.config.required_when_routing, bw.signal.store.emit_and_reread, bw.signal.store.concurrent_same_ticket, bw.signal.store.replay_survives_sync, bw.signal.store.orphaned_type_returned
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: implementers run compile-graph-scoped checks only (targeted `go test ./internal/signal/... ./internal/issue/... ./internal/intent/...` or explicitly named test files); no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, implementers run the full project verification command `make preflight`, run-until-green.
  - Verifier tier: verifiers run flipped stubs and targeted selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene covered: t.TempDir-isolated test repos, no cross-test git-state leakage
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test
- Call-site Integration: cmdSignalEmit (cmd/bw/signal.go) → issue.EmitSignal → commitWithRetry → signal intent commit. Proving tests: TestSignalEmitAndReread (test/ acceptance: emit verify PASS, re-read stored blob, assert committed intent line) and TestReplaySignal (emit then replay, record survives byte-identical from SourceHash).

Out of Scope (files):
- internal/signal/hooks*.go (Stage 2)
- cmd/bw/signal_query.go, cmd/bw/show.go, internal/md/** , prompts/** (Stage 3)
- internal/treefs/**, internal/repo/** (no store-layer changes needed)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- internal/signal/**
- internal/issue/signal*.go
- internal/intent/intent.go
- internal/intent/signal_test.go
- cmd/bw/signal.go
- cmd/bw/signal_test.go
- cmd/bw/command.go
- docs/design.md
- test/acceptance_test.go
- .spec/specs/signal_config.spec.md (verification stub flips execute:false->true only)
- .spec/specs/signal_store.spec.md (verification stub flips execute:false->true only)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No hook execution of any kind in this stage — emit is type-existence → validate → store.
- No new external Go dependencies (yaml.v3 and go-git are already present).
- Zero behavior change for repos without .beadwork/signals.yml (additivity is a merge-gate test).
- No built-in signal types; no core notion of identity/session/attribution.
- Command registration in command.go is additive only — no restructuring of existing help groups.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
